name: Tegami
source: One day, ordinary college student Satou Kouichi receives a letter from his childhood friend, Inoue Haruto, who he hasn't seen since he graduated middle school. The unexpected letter contained a description of things that recently happened to him. Why would something like this arrive now? Simply looking at it wouldn’t solve the mystery, so what should he do now? This is how the story begins.
